interpretation.label: arc007_path_memory_harm_advantage_not_reproduced
interpretation.text: ARC-007 leg 1 NOT REPRODUCED once selection is routed through E3, the DV is harm per episode at a matched episode budget, and a static no-op control is present: reduction vs the binding control A2_STATIC was 11.4% < 15% required. The candidate set offered E3 a genuine choice (P1 green), so this is a measurement rather than an instrument failure. EXQ-114's 99.2% figure was a denominator artifact of a constant action stream; ARC-007's sole behavioural support does not survive its removal, and the claim's exp_conf should be revised on this run rather than on EXQ-114. This is a decision-flipping negative, not a null. Read A2_STATIC before concluding anything about navigation: if it is the binding control, the honest reading is that standing still is at least as safe as terrain-guided navigation in this env.

preconditions.name: A0_MAP_NAV::candidate_action_diversity
preconditions.description: distinct TRUE first-action classes across the candidate set, read via HippocampalModule.candidate_first_action_class (which reads trajectory.actions, NOT the non-invertible decoder round trip). If every candidate proposes the same action then E3 has nothing to choose between and the arm is a no-op however selection is routed -- an upstream failure mode that survives the selection fix
preconditions.control: post-training positive-control probe over CEM candidate sets that genuinely differ
